items.title: Dow (DOW) Executive Chairman Made A $25 Million Cancer Care Gift
items.summary: Dow (NYSE:DOW) executive chairman Jim Fitterling has pledged a personal $25 million gift to advance cancer care initiatives. items.title: Is Dow (DOW) Stock Still Worth Watching On Sales?
items.summary: Dow Inc. has logged a sharp share price rebound in recent years, and the move raises a straightforward question for investors who focus on the link between what they pay and what the company sells. With the stock now carrying that recent performance, the issue is how well the current valuation lines up with Dow's sales base.
